features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a handheld vacuum lifter but does not mention any integrated battery power or cordless operation; it relies on manual operation for vacuum release.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: The body of the device is also preferably formed of rubber andformed integral with the body portion.
features.note: The body of the device, which forms the suction cup, is made of rubber, implying a flexible sealing surface.
features.refuted: The quote describes the material and integration of the body, not a flexible sealing lip on a suction cup bounding a sealed region.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifter that creates a vacuum by pressing the cup against a surface and releasing air, not by an electric pump.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: There is no mention of any sensor to monitor the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or monitoring of vacuum levels.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: No warning thresholds or vacuum monitoring are described in the reference.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: No warning indicators are described in the reference.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The device is manually operated and does not use a battery or an electric vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: No warning indicators are described in the reference.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The present invention has for an object the provision of a vacuum lifter which readily may be held by the operator and employed for picking up a corner portion of a sheet
features.note: The device is described as a handheld vacuum lifter for picking up sheets, implying a portable, self-contained design.
features.refuted: The quote mentions the device can be held by an operator for picking up a corner, but it does not specify 'single-hand portable design' or 'all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord'.

overall.why: The reference describes a handheld vacuum lifter with a flexible suction cup and a means to release vacuum, which aligns with the broad concept of the subject invention, but it lacks key features like an electric vacuum pump, battery power, and vacuum monitoring with warning indicators.
